report_text: Analyst notes a sharp rise in calls between Kiran Desai, Meera Patel, Anil Trivedi and Vijay Solanki in the two days before the incident.
Field source states that Nisha Shah acts as a go-between for Kiran Desai and Imran Qureshi.
Field source links vehicle SYN-GJ-1006 to Farida Sheikh.
Analyst notes unusual transfer activity on 19 August involving several accounts linked to Kiran Desai.
Unverified tip suggests Pooja Joshi and Farida Sheikh know each other.
Source reports that the stolen car was seen heading towards Surat.
Possible involvement of a driver known to Harsh Vyas.
The account of Sanjay Bhatt received funds from several unrelated senders within one week.
Anjali Kulkarni appears in more than one case this month.
Source confirms a car matching SYN-GJ-1002 was used near Ahmedabad_Zone_9 on the night of 25 August.
